prompt: How does the proposal avoid construction costs?
promptZh: 這項建議如何省下新建成本？

options.text: By asking participants to work outdoors
options.zh: 要求參與者在戶外工作

options.whyZh: 不會靠降低網速省建築費。

options.text: By using rooms in existing buildings
options.whyZh: 採用社區中心會議室，不必蓋新建築。
